parties:
Amena Begum and others
Vs.
Bangladesh House Building Finance Corporation
full_judgment:
Mohammad Abdur Rashid, J: This Rule was issued against an order being No. 40 dated 26.10.99 passed by the District Judge in Dhaka in Miscellaneous Case No. 375 of 1995, which rejected a prayer for an order recording abatement of the case. 

 2. Short facts for disposal are that the opposite party, the House Building Finance corporation filed the above case before the District Judge in Dhaka by making an application under Article 27 of the presidential Order 7 of 19.73 against the borrower Lutful Hoque Mujumder for an order for sale of the property in question for failure of the borrower to pay its debts. On 27.06.96 said Lutful Hoque Mujumder died leaving behind the petitioners as his on heirs and`' legal' representatives. On 26.10.99 the petitioners made an application under order 22 Rule 4 of the Code of Civil Procedure for an order abating the proceeding. Same date, the application was heard and rejected. Hence, the Rule. 

 3. No one is found, to press the Rule though the name of the learned advocate has been appearing in the, list since 05.07.93 the case was posted. 

 4. Mr. K.S. Zaman, the learned senior advocate on behalf of the opposite party Corporation submits that as the proceeding brought under Article 27 of the President order No. 07 of 1973 is a special case under a special law for recovery of debts and the Code of Civil Procedure has not been made applicable in such proceeding, the application for recording abatement is not maintainable. 

 6. We have perused the application. It appears that the application for recording abatement was styled one under order 21 rule 24 of the Code. Secondly, we find Mr. Zaman to correct to say that the Code of Civil Procedure is not made applicable in such proceedings. Thirdly, when the petitioners were already added on their own initiative, the application for recording the abatement appears to be Misconceived. 

 9. The learned District Judge is directed to dispose of the case, expeditiously.
